skills.name: gecs-core
skills.description: Use when setting up GECS, wiring the ECS singleton and World, creating the first Entity/Component/System, or applying the v9 foundational lifecycle rules in Godot 4.3+.

skills.name: gecs-debugging
skills.description: Use when diagnosing GECS runtime behavior with the Debug Viewer, Step Debugger, breakpoints, system/entity diffs, dependency tracking, or debugger transport.

skills.name: gecs-entities-components
skills.description: Use when designing GECS entities and pure-data component resources, scene glue, component configuration, naming, lifecycle hooks, or aliases.

skills.name: gecs-observers
skills.description: Use when implementing reactive GECS observers, match/unmatch monitors, component property events, relationship events, custom world events, or sub-observers.

skills.name: gecs-performance
skills.description: Use when profiling GECS FPS, query cache behavior, structural churn, entity pooling, change detection, benchmarks, or scaling a GDScript ECS workload.

skills.name: gecs-queries
skills.description: Use when building GECS queries, component property filters, cached queries, pre-narrowed arrays, relationship filtering, or v9 change detection.

skills.name: gecs-relationships
skills.description: Use when linking entities, components, or archetypes, querying relation pairs and wildcards, stacking effects, or removing relationship stacks safely.

skills.name: gecs-serialization
skills.description: Use when implementing GECS save/load, level export, selective component serialization, binary resource files, or entity relationship persistence.

skills.name: gecs-systems
skills.description: Use when implementing GECS systems, processing groups, tick rates, SoA iteration, sub-systems, dependency ordering, or deferred structural changes with CommandBuffer.

skills.name: gecs-troubleshooting-migration
skills.description: Use when diagnosing common GECS setup failures or migrating code and saves from legacy Observer APIs and v8 behavior to GECS v9.

skills.name: gecs-world-architecture
skills.description: Use when organizing World, System groups, Entity scenes, level switching, entity pooling, lifecycle cleanup, compacting archetypes, or large-mass rendering.
